comportamentos: Validation blocking creation of an EnrollmentHold when class enrollments exist in the held period (error class_enrollments_exist): missing (the candidate deletes the enrollments instead)
Invalidate the class enrollment requests of the held semester after the hold is created or updated (invalidate_enrollment_requests): missing
Validation on ClassEnrollment preventing enrollment while the enrollment is held (check_enrollment_hold / enrollment_is_held): missing
Validation on ClassEnrollmentRequest preventing requests in a held period: missing
Active status of a hold computed from its dates, plus search by currently held enrollments (currently_active, hold_in_date): missing
Student enrollment screen showing the held enrollment and hiding the enrollment link: missing
CourseClass#start_date/end_date helpers used to check period overlap: missing
justificativa: The candidate only destroys registered class enrollments in the held semesters, while the official fix blocks holds that overlap existing enrollments, invalidates the requests and stops new enrollments or requests during the hold, so the observable behavior differs substantially.
